sloka: अथवा रक्ष्यतां रामो यावत् सञ्ज्ञाविपर्ययः ।लब्धसञ्ज्ञौ हि काकुत्स्थौ भयं नो व्यपनेष्यतः ।। ६.४६.४० ।।।।
transliteration: athavā rakṣyatāṁ rāmo yāvat sañjñāviparyayaḥ ।labdhasañjñau hi kākutsthau bhayaṁ no vyapaneṣyataḥ ।। 6.46.40 ।।।।

translations.english: "Therefore, Rama has no fear of death, even a little. Whatever splendour is lost, prosperity will not leave him."
